**Extraction criteria:** cohesive package, distinct data ownership, small inbound fan-in (i.e. absent from the betweenness bridge list), and a natural API boundary.

**Good candidates (by package, class counts via `find --scope`):**
- **Dunning** — `de.metas.dunning` (123 classes; graph community 163 "dunning", 951 members). Downstream of invoicing, batch/letter lifecycle, little inbound coupling.
- **Printing / print queue** — `de.metas.printing` (253 classes). Queue-driven, self-contained infrastructure with a narrow surface.
- **POS channel** — `de.metas.pos` (209 classes). Remote-command API already bounds it; good strangler boundary.
- **Purchase candidate / procurement** — `de.metas.purchasecandidate` (118 classes). Clean candidate→PO seam, though it touches planning.
- **External-system / EDI connectors** — adapter-style, plugin architecture, separated by design.

**Avoid extracting:**

events.text: Explain this architecture to a new engineer in five sentences.

Metasfresh is a large Java/Maven ERP (~960k graph nodes, 3M edges) derived from Compiere/ADempiere, split into many `de.metas.*` backend modules behind Swing and web UIs. A thin shared kernel — `de.metas.business`, `de.metas.swat.base`, `org.compiere`, and `de.metas.adempiere.adempiere/base` — holds the document model and low-level services that nearly every domain depends on. Functional domains are mapped around business flows: order-to-cash (`de.metas.order` → `inoutcandidate` → `handlingunits`/picking → `invoicecandidate` → `de.metas.payment` → `de.metas.dunning`), procure-to-pay (`purchasecandidate`, `rfq`), manufacturing, and inventory/warehouse. The architecture is only weakly modular (modularity 0.553, ~18k communities), with most cross-domain traffic funneled through a material-disposition planning hub (`de.metas.material/dispo-commons`, which holds 8 of the top-10 betweenness bridges). Domain logic reaches the database through generated `X_*`/`I_*` model classes and interceptors rather than a repository layer, so boundaries are soft and changes ripple broadly.
